title: Tamil Nadu Politics – Evening Brief – 31 October 2026
headline: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay is completely out of touch, lacks independent decision-making: EPS

sections.big_picture:
- **Tamil Nadu CM Vijay is completely out of touch, lacks independent decision-making: EPS:** CHENGALPET: AIADMK general secretary and former chief minister Edappadi K Palaniswami (EPS) on Saturday launched a blistering attack on the TVK govt, Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay The development directly involves AIADMK, DMK, TVK in Tamil Nadu as part of wider policy discussions surrounding government & administration. Reporting from NDTV, The Times of India indicates that party representatives and senior officials are closely tracking the public response and subsequent administrative steps.

- **Theni jailbreak: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay orders suspension of Theni district jail superintendent in-charge:** R. Krishnaraj, Superintendent of Madurai Central Prison, has been transferred and posted as Superintendent of Salem Central Prison Chennai's Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay has ordered the suspension of the deputy jail superintendent in charge of Thekkampatti sub-jail. This action stems from significant security lapses that allowed 17 prisoners to escape after overpowering guards. The Tamil Nadu Police quickly recaptured all escapees through a coordinated operation, which included using drones. The government has also initiated severe punitive measures against negligent prison personnel and transferred several senior officials.

- **DMK women cadre protest across Tamil Nadu over price rise, law and order:** DMK Women’s Wing protests across Tamil Nadu over price rise, law-and-order, and alleged child safety failures under the TVK government. “The women have rung the bell. The government, which is hunting down its critics and preparing for a show in the byelection, should pay attention to governance,” he said in a social media post

- **Tamil Nadu Congress, VCK mobilise cadres for Nov. 1 INDIA bloc protest in New Delhi:** “We expect more than five lakh Congress cadres to participate. From Tamil Nadu, we are expecting at least 100 party workers to reach New Delhi from each district,” says MP R. Sudha The development directly involves INC, VCK in Tamil Nadu as part of wider policy discussions surrounding centre–state relations, political parties, public protests & labour. Reporting from The Hindu indicates that party representatives and senior officials are closely tracking the public response and subsequent administrative steps.

- **AMMK Dhinakaran targets Vijay govt over power cuts, questions energy minister's continuance:** T T V Dhinakaran has publicly confronted the Tamil Nadu government for persistent power outages he attributes to gross administrative incompetence. He pointed out chronic issues like sudden power cuts and billing discrepancies, which significantly impact residents. Citing the outage at Meenakshi Amman temple as a critical example, Dhinakaran demanded urgent reforms in the electricity sector and called on Chief Minister Joseph Vijay to take decisive action against negligent officials.
